title: Voice Operations Engineer – 24×7 Customer Support
description:

Kore.ai’s goal is to empower businesses with effective, simple and responsible AI solutions that create engaging interactions. sectors serving over 100M of consumers and 500,000+ employees worldwide. Founded in 2014 by serial successful entrepreneur, Raj Koneru, Kore.ai supports customers globally across offices in Orlando, Hyderabad, New York, London, Germany, Dubai Frankfurt, Tokyo and Seoul.

We’re reshaping the way companies harness the power of AI, simplifying and enhancing accessibility. Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry to pioneer safe, reliable solutions. Join the Kore.ai team and help companies of all sizes simplify the adoption of advanced AI solutions responsibly.

**Voice Operations Engineer – 24×7 Customer Support**

**About the Role**

* We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused Voice Operations Engineer to join our 24×7
* Voice Gateway Operations team. The role will support enterprise customers, troubleshoot
* real-time voice and telephony issues, monitor production environments, and ensure timely
* resolution of incidents across global regions.
* The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of voice protocols, networking, Linux
* administration, monitoring tools, and excellent customer communication skills. The ability to
* remain calm under pressure, ask the right diagnostic questions, and clearly articulate
* technical findings is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide 24×7 operational support for Voice Gateway, telephony, SIP, RTP, SBC, and

contact-center environments.

* Monitor voice infrastructure, call quality, service availability, traffic patterns, and system health.
* Troubleshoot issues related to call failures, call drops, one-way audio, no audio, DTMF, codec negotiation, SIP registration, routing, and media connectivity.
* Analyze SIP signaling and RTP media flows to identify the root cause of customer-

impacting issues.

* Use tools such as Homer, Grafana, VoIP monitoring platforms, logs, traces, dashboards, and packet captures for troubleshooting.
* Investigate network, firewall, DNS, NAT, routing, port-access, and connectivity-related issues.
* Work with customers to collect call IDs, timestamps, SIP traces, source IPs, network

details, recordings, and other relevant diagnostic information.

* Communicate clearly with customers during incidents, explain the problem statement, provide regular updates, and set appropriate expectations.
* Collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, QA, Product, carriers, SBC teams, and third-

party vendors to drive issues to closure.

* Perform initial incident triage, impact assessment, escalation, and follow-up based on defined SLAs.
* Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting notes, root-cause analysis, and

customer communication history.

* Support production deployments, configuration changes, service restarts, feature

enablement, and post-change validation.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive actions to improve platform reliabilityand customer experience.
* Participate in shift rotations, weekend coverage, incident bridges, and major customer escalations.

**Required Qualifications**

3–5 years of experience in Voice Operations, NOC, Technical Support, Network Operations, Telecom Operations, or a related role.

**Strong understanding of voice and telephony protocols, including:**

* SIP
* RTP/RTCP
* SDP
* SIP REGISTER, INVITE, ACK, BYE, CANCEL, REFER, and 200 OK flows
* DTMF, codecs, NAT traversal, and media negotiation

**Hands-on experience troubleshooting voice issues such as:**

* Call setup failures
* Call drops and mid-call disconnects
* One-way or no audio
* Audio quality issues
* SIP registration failures
* DTMF failures
* Transfer and routing issues
* Carrier or SBC connectivity problems
* Good knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, NAT,
* routing, firewalls, ACLs, TLS, and port connectivity.
* Working knowledge of Linux administration, commands, services, logs, processes,
* networking, and basic performance troubleshooting.

**Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as:**

* Homer
* Grafana
* VoIP monitoring platforms
* Prometheus, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent tools
* Ability to analyze logs, SIP traces, packet captures, and call-flow data.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging, and incident-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly explain technical issues, findings, impact, and next steps to customers and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with SBCs, SIP carriers, cloud telephony, contact-center platforms, or CPaaS solutions.
* Familiarity with FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, RTP engines, AudioCodes, Twilio, or similar
* voice technologies.
* Experience using Wireshark, tcpdump, sngrep, SIPp, or similar troubleshooting tools.
* Exposure to AWS, GCP, or other cloud environments.
* Knowledge of call-quality metrics such as MOS, jitter, latency, packet loss, and packet-delay variation.
* Experience supporting global enterprise customers in a managed services or SaaS
* environment.
* ITIL certification or experience with structured incident and problem-management
* processes.

**Key Attributes**

* Customer-focused and committed to timely issue resolution.
* Calm, composed, and effective during high-pressure incidents.
* Strong listener who can ask precise and relevant diagnostic questions.
* Able to convert complex technical findings into a clear customer-facing problem
* statement.
* Fast learner with the ability to adapt to new tools, technologies, and customer
* environments.
* Self-driven and accountable, with strong ownership of assigned incidents.
* Collaborative team player who works effectively across Engineering, DevOps, Product,and Customer Success.
* Flexible and comfortable working in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.
* Proactive in identifying recurring problems and improving operational processes.

**Work Schedule**

This role requires participation in a 24×7 rotational shift model, including night shifts,

weekends, and public holidays as part of the operations support schedule.

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATION:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field(MCA).

title: QA Engineer (Healthcare Domain)
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a experienced QA Engineers with strong knowledge of **Healthcare Interoperability, HL7, FHIR, APIs, and healthcare data exchange workflows**.

The resource will be responsible for validating the interoperability platform, including healthcare message exchange, data transformation, mapping, routing, API integrations, and end\-to\-end communication between healthcare systems such as EHR/EMR, laboratories, HIEs, and other external systems.

The candidate should be comfortable validating both functional workflows and the underlying healthcare data/messages.

Experience

* 4\+ years of overall Software Testing / QA experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in **Healthcare IT / Healthcare Interoperability testing** preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with **HL7 v2\.x and/or FHIR** is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience in API and integration testing.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing of the interoperability platform.
* Validate healthcare data exchange between source and target systems.
* Test **HL7 messages** such as ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, MDM or similar healthcare message types.
* Validate HL7 segments, fields, message structure, mandatory/optional fields, and business rules.
* Test **FHIR REST APIs and FHIR resources** such as:
* Patient
* Encounter
* Observation
* Practitioner
* Organization
* Condition
* DiagnosticReport
* Medication / MedicationRequest
* Appointment
* Validate healthcare data transformation and mapping between:
* HL7 → HL7
* HL7 → FHIR
* FHIR → HL7
* API / JSON / XML and other supported formats.
* Verify message routing, filtering, transformation, acknowledgement, and delivery.
* Validate HL7 ACK/NACK messages and error\-handling scenarios.
* Test inbound and outbound interfaces with external systems.
* Perform positive, negative, boundary, duplicate, missing\-data, and invalid\-data testing.
* Validate data consistency from source system through AERIS to the destination system.
* Perform REST API testing including GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE operations.
* Validate API request/response payloads, headers, status codes, authentication, authorization, and error responses.
* Validate FHIR resources against applicable profiles and implementation requirements.
* Test interface failures, retry mechanisms, message queues, duplicate processing, timeout and recovery scenarios.
* Perform database validation where required to ensure data integrity.
* Prepare detailed test scenarios, test cases, test data and execution evidence.
* Identify, document, track and retest defects through Jira or similar defect\-management tools.
* Work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Solution Architects and Integration teams.
* Participate in requirement reviews and identify interoperability/testing gaps before development.
* Support release validation and production/post\-deployment verification when required.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Strong manual testing fundamentals.
* Strong **API testing** experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **Postman** or similar API\-testing tools.
* Good understanding of **REST APIs, JSON and XML**.
* Knowledge of **HL7 v2\.x messaging**.
* Understanding of HL7 structure including:
* MSH
* PID
* PV1
* ORC
* OBR
* OBX
* ACK
* Understanding of **FHIR concepts and FHIR REST APIs**.
* Familiarity with common FHIR resources and relationships.
* Good understanding of healthcare system integration and interoperability concepts.
* SQL/database validation knowledge.
* Experience with Jira or equivalent test/defect\-management tools.
* Ability to troubleshoot integration failures using application logs, API responses and message payloads.

Good to Have

* Experience working with interface engines or healthcare integration platforms.
* Experience with tools such as **Mirth Connect / NextGen Connect, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf, InterSystems or similar platforms**.
* Knowledge of **FHIR R4**.
* Experience with FHIR validation tools or FHIR servers.
* Knowledge of SMART on FHIR and OAuth 2\.0\.
* Understanding of healthcare terminologies such as:
* ICD\-10
* SNOMED CT
* LOINC
* RxNorm
* Knowledge of CDA / C\-CDA.
* Understanding of healthcare security, PHI and HIPAA\-related requirements.
* Experience in automation of API/integration testing using tools or frameworks such as Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Playwright, Python or equivalent.

**About the Role**



Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting\-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self\-driven, hands\-on team member who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.



The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives.



The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Test Planning \& Strategy**


* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies.
* Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities.


**Functional \& Regression Testing**


* Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities.
* Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance\-related business processes.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations.
* Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes.
* Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments.


**Integration \& Data Testing**


* Test integrations with third\-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman.
* Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems.
* Support testing of end\-to\-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications.


**Compliance \& Security Testing**


* Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions.
* Perform role\-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification.
* Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements.
* Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems.


**Performance \& Automation Testing**


* Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites.
* Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance.
* Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities.


**Defect Tracking \& Collaboration**


* Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management tools.
* Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Best Practices**


* Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices.
* Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.
* Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.
